Eri, first meeting. Start screen (pick a farmer and a scythe). Big box. Eri slips: 'crashed' then corrects to 'came'.
en: Oh, a ship! Nobody has crashed here in ages. Sorry, I mean nobody has come here.
tr: Aa, bir gemi! Uzun zamandır buraya kimse düşmemişti. Pardon, gelmemişti demek istedim.

note: Same conversation, line 2. Friendly on the surface, possessive underneath.
en: I'm Eri, and this planet is mine. If you're staying, you'll be the one working my field. Deal?
tr: Ben Eri, bu gezegen de benim. Burada kalacaksan tarlamı sen ekip biçeceksin, anlaştık mı?

note: Same conversation, line 3. Farmer and scythe are the two choices on this screen.
en: First you need to pick a farmer and a scythe. We'll handle the rest together.
tr: Önce bir çiftçi ve bir tırpan seçmelisin. Gerisini birlikte hallederiz.

note: Preparation screen, first run. Big box. The field is still empty; the player must buy a planter (pot) in the planter shop, then start the round.
en: The field is empty! First you need to buy a planter from the shop, then you can start the round.
tr: Tarla bomboş! Önce dükkândan bir saksı almalısın, sonra turu başlatabilirsin.

note: Planter placement mode, first time. Big box. Clicking an empty field cell places it; the R key rotates it.
en: Click an empty spot to place the planter. You can rotate it with R.
tr: Saksıyı koymak için boş bir yere tıklamalısın. R tuşuyla da döndürebilirsin.

note: First round starts. Small box during play. Attacks are automatic while the cursor is over plants. Teasing tone (a joke).
en: Don't know how to harvest? Just keep the cursor over the plants and the scythe swings by itself.
tr: Hasat etmeyi bilmiyor musun? İmleci bitkilerin üstünde tutman yeterli, tırpan kendisi vurur.

note: Same conversation, line 2. Joke AND the story's first hidden hint: Eri remembers Earth's technology (it has been to Earth). Keep it casual; do not explain or make it obvious.
en: Hmm, don't they have automatic scythes on Earth? I was sure they did.
tr: Hmm, Dünya'da otomatik tırpan yok mu? Ben var sanıyordum.

note: First round, after the previous line. Small box. Offering (TR: Adak) = the harvest share offered to Eri (the quota panel, top left). Game term: translate consistently.
en: That share at the top left is my Offering. You need to fill it before the period ends, okay?
tr: Sol üstteki pay benim Adağım. Dönem bitmeden onu doldurmalısın, tamam mı?

note: First level-up: card choice screen. Big box. The chosen card lasts for this run.
en: You leveled up! Now pick a card. It stays with you until the run ends.
tr: Seviye atladın! Şimdi bir kart seçmelisin, deneme bitene kadar seninle kalacak.

note: Last round of an Offering period starts and the Offering is not full yet (first time). Small box during play.
en: This is the last round of the period and my Offering is still short. You need to hurry!
tr: Bu dönemin son turu ve Adağım hâlâ eksik. Acele etmelisin!

note: An Offering period was met for the first time. Round end screen, big box. Satisfied, slightly unsettling.
Same conversation, line 2. Second reading: the hunger keeps growing.
en: For now, anyway. Next time I'll want a bit more.
tr: Şimdilik doydum. Ama bir dahaki sefere daha fazlasını isteyeceğim.

note: First Trial (TR: Sınama; boss) round starts. Small box during play. Trial = boss round; its own target is shown in the left panel. Game term: translate consistently.
en: This round is a Trial! You need to fill the target on the left before the round ends.
tr: Bu tur bir Sınama! Soldaki hedefi tur bitmeden doldurmalısın.

note: First field event (one of Eri's wild seeds) is about to appear. Small box during play. Its plate on the left says what it does (some must be cut, some give a bonus).
en: One of my seeds has gone wild! You can read what it does on the left.
tr: Tohumlarımdan biri azdı! Ne yaptığını soldaki yazıdan okuyabilirsin.

note: Run ended because the Offering was not met (first time). Big box. Hungry, cold.
en: You didn't fill my Offering. I can't wait around hungry.

note: Same conversation, line 2.
en: Oh well, we'll start over. I'm not going anywhere.
tr: Neyse, baştan başlarız. Ben bir yere gitmiyorum.

note: Run ended because a Trial (boss round) was failed (first time). Big box.
en: You didn't pass the Trial. I can't wait any longer either.
tr: Sınamayı geçemedin. Ben de daha fazla bekleyemem.

note: Same conversation, line 2.
en: But you'll be back. I know you will.

note: Run won (first time). Big box. Content, with an unsettling second reading.
en: Mmm! I'm full. Really full this time.
tr: Mmm! Doydum. Bu sefer gerçekten doydum.

tr: Sadece kendi vuruşunu etkiler: imleç halkası büyür. Davranışların alanı değişmez.

Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.

tr: Vuruşların arası kısalır, ama 0,10 saniyenin altına inmez.

en: Only boosts your own hit. Behavior damage stays the same.
tr: Sadece kendi vuruşunu güçlendirir. Davranış hasarı değişmez.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.

tr: Patlama, kasırga, bumerang ve elektrik şansını artırır. Şansı hiç olmayan saksıya şans vermez. En fazla %100.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: Only affects your own hit. Added to the chance as percentage points.
tr: Sadece kendi vuruşunu etkiler. Şansa yüzde puan olarak eklenir.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: Works on all planters. Added as percentage points, up to 95 points.
tr: Bütün saksılarda geçerli. Yüzde puan olarak eklenir, en fazla 95 puan.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: Boosts explosion, tornado, boomerang and electric. Your own hit stays the same.
tr: Patlama, kasırga, bumerang ve elektriği güçlendirir. Kendi vuruşun değişmez.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: An empty swing doesn't use the charge. The powered hit doesn't earn a new one. Behaviors aren't affected.
tr: Boşa savurmak hakkı harcamaz. Güçlenmiş vuruş yeni hak kazandırmaz. Davranışları etkilemez.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: The repeated behavior starts no chain and rolls no new chance. The limit on tornadoes and boomerangs at once still holds.
tr: Tekrar eden davranış zincir başlatmaz, yeni şans da atmaz. Aynı anda olabilecek kasırga ve bumerang sayısı aşılmaz.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: The crescent travels 4 units instead of 3 and grows as it goes. Its damage only grows with real harvests. Full Moon is big from the start and doesn't grow.
tr: Hilal 3 yerine 4 birim gider ve ilerledikçe büyür. Hasarı ise sadece gerçekten hasat ettikçe artar. Dolunay baştan büyüktür, büyümez.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: Each main crescent comes with one more big crescent, no harvest needed. It leaves the cursor ring in another direction. A Full Moon makes no new Full Moon.
tr: Her ana hilalle birlikte büyük bir hilal daha çıkar, hasat şartı yok. İmleç halkasından başka bir yöne gider. Dolunaydan yeni Dolunay çıkmaz.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: The antenna stands on the field edge and takes no planter space. Its hit doesn't count as yours: no crits, no behavior triggers.
tr: Anten tarlanın kenarında durur, saksılara yer kaplamaz. Vuruşu senin vuruşun sayılmaz: kritik yapmaz, davranış tetiklemez.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: Only harvests from your own hits count. A meteor makes no new meteor.
tr: Sadece kendi vuruşunla yaptığın hasatlar sayılır. Göktaşından yeni göktaşı çıkmaz.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: The crescent leaves the cursor ring's edge in a random direction. It normally travels 3 units, 4 with Growing Moon.
tr: Hilal, imleç halkasının kenarından rastgele bir yöne fırlar. Normalde 3 birim gider, Büyüyen Ay ile 4.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: You choose where the second antenna goes. Spots where no line can form can't be picked. Line hits don't count as yours.
tr: İkinci antenin yerini sen seçersin. Hat kurulamayan yerler seçilemez. Hat vuruşu senin vuruşun sayılmaz.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: The extra line hit starts no further extra hits. Does nothing without a planter that has a behavior.
tr: Ek hat vuruşu yeni ek vuruş başlatmaz. Davranışı olan saksı yoksa işe yaramaz.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: The crit jumps to a plant your hit didn't touch. The jump doesn't crit or jump again.
tr: Kritik, vuruşunun değmediği bir bitkiye sıçrar. Sıçrayan vuruş kritik yapmaz, yeniden sıçramaz.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: Raises explosion, tornado, boomerang and electric chances. A planter with no chance gets none. Up to 100%.
tr: Patlama, kasırga, bumerang ve elektrik şansını artırır. Şansı hiç olmayan saksıya şans vermez. En fazla %100.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: Only starts from a plant you killed with your own hit. Passed-on damage doesn't crit.
tr: Sadece kendi vuruşunla öldürdüğün bitkiden başlar. Aktarılan hasar kritik yapmaz.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: Spreads three steps from the explosion's outer edge. Hits each cell once and doesn't pass locked cells. An aftershock starts no new aftershock or chain.
tr: Patlamanın dış kenarından üç adım yayılır. Her hücreye bir kez vurur, kilitli hücrelerden geçmez. Artçıdan yeni artçı ya da zincir çıkmaz.

note: Boss reward name (card title, lists).
Boss reward effect label; the value follows (e.g. 'Attack interval ×0.90'). Keep a trailing colon if there is one.
Boss reward card, small note under the effect.
en: After every electric that triggers, a second wave comes from the same planter. No new chance is rolled, and the second wave starts no chain.
tr: Şansı tutan her elektrikten sonra aynı saksıdan ikinci bir dalga çıkar. Bunun için yeni şans atılmaz, ikinci dalga zincir başlatmaz.

Story 1/14, after the first Trial (boss round) is passed. Big box. Eri happy and proud; she is secretly the villain, keep a sweet tone.
en: You passed a Trial! My leaves are shaking with joy.
tr: Bir Sınamayı geçtin! Sevinçten yapraklarım titriyor.

note: Story 1/14, line 2. She lies: in the very first talk she mentioned Earth. Two answer buttons follow.
en: Where did your ship come from again? Earth? Hmm… never heard of it.
tr: Senin gemin nereden gelmişti? Dünya mı? Hımm… hiç duymadım.

note: Story 1/14, player's answer button 1 (trusting). Short. The choice is remembered for the ending.
Story 1/14, Eri's reply to answer 1.
Story 1/14, player's answer button 2 (doubting). Short. The choice is remembered for the ending.
Story 1/14, Eri's reply to answer 2: flustered, covering up.
en: Hmmm… Earth, Earth… maybe I have heard of it, who knows.
tr: Iıımm… Dünya, Dünya… belki duymuşumdur, bilmem ki.

note: Story 1/14, last line. A warning disguised as worry.
en: But don't get too strong, okay? Strong farmers always end up leaving one day.
tr: Ama çok da güçlenme, olur mu? Güçlü çiftçiler bir gün hep çekip gidiyor.

note: Story 2/14, after the first boss reward is taken. Eri happy.
en: The field gave you that reward. I think the field really likes you.
tr: Bu ödülü sana tarla verdi. Bence tarla seni çok sevdi.

note: Story 2/14, line 2. 'Strong hands' = she needs workers.
en: I like you too. I need hard-working hands like yours.
tr: Ben de seni sevdim. Senin gibi çalışkan ellere ihtiyacım var.

note: Story 3/14, preparation screen before round 5. Eri happy.
en: Five rounds already! You're not bad, farmer.
tr: Beş tur oldu bile! Fena değilsin, çiftçi.

note: Story 3/14, line 2. Hint: the player's work feeds her.
en: The more you work, the more I grow. I'd say that's a good deal for both of us.
tr: Sen çalıştıkça ben büyüyorum. Bence ikimiz için de iyi bir anlaşma.

note: Story 4/14, before round 10. Offering (Adak) = the quota the player must harvest for Eri.
en: Why do I want the Offering? To grow, of course.
tr: Adağı neden mi istiyorum? Büyümek için tabii ki.

note: Story 4/14, line 2.
en: The more you give me, the bigger I get. You want to grow too, I know it.
tr: Sen bana ne kadar verirsen ben o kadar büyürüm. Sen de büyümek istiyorsun, biliyorum.

note: Story 5/14, before round 15. Eri happy, but a dark hint.
en: Other farmers came before you. They all worked so hard.
tr: Senden önce de çiftçiler geldi. Hepsi çok çalışkandı.

note: Story 5/14, line 2. She hesitates and lies (they did not leave).
en: Then… they left. Yes, they all left.

note: Story 6/14, before round 20. Eri happy; she plants doubt about the crash.
en: Ever wondered why your ship crashed? You had fuel, and your engine was fine.
tr: Gemin neden düştü, hiç düşündün mü? Yakıtın vardı, motorun da sağlamdı.

note: Story 6/14, line 2. Changes the subject.
en: Anyway, never mind that. You're happy here.
tr: Neyse, boş ver bunu. Burada mutlusun işte.

note: Story 7/14, before round 25. From here Eri is grey and sad: she will lose the player and her secret is about to come out.
en: I never thought you'd make it this far…
tr: Bu kadar ileri gideceğini hiç düşünmemiştim…

note: Story 7/14, line 2. 'Wilted' = she has turned grey.
en: I've wilted a little, have you noticed? The stronger you get, the more scared I am.
tr: Biraz soldum, fark ettin mi? Sen güçlendikçe korkmaya başladım.

note: Story 7/14, line 3. Two answer buttons follow (not remembered).
en: I wish I could play with you a little longer. But soon you'll start asking questions.
tr: Seninle biraz daha oynamak isterdim. Ama yakında soru sormaya başlayacaksın.

note: Story 7/14, player's answer button 1. Short.
Story 7/14, Eri's reply to answer 1.
en: Nothing. You should mind your harvest.

note: Story 7/14, player's answer button 2. Short.
Story 7/14, Eri's reply to answer 2: sad, knowing.
Story 8/14, before round 30. Eri sad. The blue field is Earth (said openly later).
en: I used to have a huge blue field. Its core was so warm.
tr: Eskiden kocaman, mavi bir tarlam vardı. Çekirdeği sıcacıktı.

note: Story 8/14, line 2. She ate it.
en: I ate all of it. Mmm… I can still taste it.
tr: Hepsini yedim. Mmm… tadı hâlâ damağımda.

note: Story 9/14, before round 35. Eri sad, confessing: she consumed the earlier farmers.
en: The other farmers didn't leave. I harvested them.
tr: Önceki çiftçiler gitmedi. Onları ben hasat ettim.

note: Story 9/14, line 2.
en: You'll be angry with me. They all were.

note: Story 10/14, before round 40. Eri sad, confessing: she made the player's ship crash.
en: Ships don't just fall out of the sky. I pulled yours down.
tr: Gemiler kendi kendine düşmez. Seninkini ben aşağı çektim.

note: Story 10/14, line 2.
en: I needed your hands. I still do.

note: Story 11/14, before round 45. Eri sad. She all but names Earth.
en: That blue field had a name. Your ship took off from there.
tr: Mavi tarlanın bir adı vardı. Senin gemin oradan kalktı.

note: Story 11/14, line 2.
Story 12/14, before the last round (the final Trial). Eri sad, but calculating.
en: This is the last Trial. Pass it and you'll have beaten me.
tr: Bu son Sınama. Geçersen beni yenmiş olacaksın.

note: Story 12/14, line 2. Either outcome serves her.
en: Fail it and you'll stay here. Either way, I win.
tr: Geçemezsen yine burada kalacaksın. İki türlü de ben kazanırım.

note: Story 13/14, victory screen of the first full win. Line 1: Eri still grey and sad.
en: You won. You made it all the way to the end…

note: Story 13/14, line 2: the mask falls, Eri turns red (her true self). Cold, triumphant.
en: Then the game is over. I don't need to hide anymore.
tr: O zaman oyun bitti. Artık saklanmama gerek yok.

note: Story 13/14, line 3. Full confession.
en: Yes. I ate Earth's core. And I brought your ship down.
tr: Evet. Dünya'nın çekirdeğini ben yedim. Gemini de ben düşürdüm.

note: Story 13/14, line 4, only if the player trusted her in story 1 ('Alright, if you say so').
en: You trusted me. That's the part I loved most.
tr: Bana güvendin. En çok da bunu sevdim.

note: Story 13/14, line 4, only if the player doubted her in story 1 ('Are you sure?').
en: You suspected me, and you were right. But you stayed anyway.
tr: Benden şüphelendin, haklıydın da. Ama yine de kaldın.

note: Story 13/14, line 5. Her sadness was an act too.
en: I was never sad, farmer. I was just hungry.

note: Story 13/14, last line. The cycle goes on.
en: Come on, keep harvesting. I need to get stronger for the next planet.
tr: Hadi, hasada devam et. Bir sonraki gezegen için güçlenmem lazım.

note: Story 14/14, start of the first run after the first full win. Eri red, openly the villain. Offering = the quota.
en: We know each other now. Come on, my Offering is waiting for you.
tr: Artık birbirimizi tanıyoruz. Hadi, Adağım seni bekliyor.

note: Story 14/14, line 2.
en: You can't run. You have no ship and no Earth. There's only me here.
tr: Kaçamazsın. Ne gemin var ne de Dünya'n. Burada bir tek ben varım.
